title: Ulysses: A Security Harness For Synthesizing Verifiable Web Exploits
abstract: arXiv:2610.31831v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How can an AI agent automatically discover security vulnerabilities in any software repository? Existing approaches use LLMs to generate software vulnerability exploits. However, it is challenging for an LLM to reliably verify its own generated exploits. In this paper, we propose Ulysses, a multi-agent security harness to synthesize verifiable vulnerability exploits for web applications. Ulysses converts candidate vulnerability findings into verified Proofs of Exploitability by iteratively exploring exploit hypotheses and establishing success in independently observed execution effects. We evaluated Ulysses on WebExploitGym, a curated benchmark of exploitable instances from 25 real-world web applications that span 5 languages and 7 frameworks. Ulysses produces verified proofs for 10 of 25 real-world advisories. It also discovered 4 new proofs of exploitability that have never been previously reported.

translated_title: Ulysses：一个用于合成可验证网络漏洞利用的安全测试框架
translated_abstract: AI智能体如何能在任意软件仓库中自动发现安全漏洞？现有方法使用大语言模型（LLM）来生成软件漏洞利用程序，然而，LLM很难可靠地验证其自身生成的漏洞利用程序。在本文中，我们提出了Ulysses，一个多智能体安全测试框架，用于为Web应用程序合成可验证的漏洞利用程序。Ulysses通过迭代探索漏洞利用假设，并在独立观察到的执行效果中确立成功，将候选漏洞发现转化为经过验证的可利用性证明。我们在WebExploitGym上评估了Ulysses，这是一个精选的基准测试集，包含来自25个真实世界Web应用的可利用实例，涵盖5种语言和7个框架。Ulysses为25个真实安全公告中的10个生成了经过验证的证明，还发现了4个此前从未被报道过的新可利用性证明。
tldr: Ulysses是一个多智能体安全测试框架，通过迭代探索漏洞假设并结合独立观察的执行效果验证，将候选漏洞发现转化为可验证的可利用性证明，在25个真实Web应用中成功验证了10个已知漏洞并新发现4个此前未报道的漏洞。
en_tdlr: Ulysses is a multi-agent security harness that synthesizes verifiable web vulnerability exploits by iteratively exploring exploit hypotheses and establishing success through independently observed execution effects, verifying 10 of 25 real-world advisories and discovering 4 previously unreported proofs of exploitability.
